frases.alumno: Keeping your receipt is very useful if you need to exchange an item.

texto: Contextual reading of an everyday purchase: read the exchange between a buyer and the shopkeeper in a souvenir or handicraft shop. Notice how the buyer asks to see the item, how they find out the price, and how they confirm whether both items have the same value.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ป้ายแสดงราคาสินค้าที่ชัดเจนช่วยให้ผู้ซื้อเปรียบเทียบและตัดสินใจได้ง่ายขึ้น» express?

opciones.texto: Clear labels with visible prices make it easier to compare purchases.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ป้ายแสดงราคาสินค้าที่ชัดเจนช่วยให้ผู้ซื้อเปรียบเทียบและตัดสินใจได้ง่ายขึ้น» from the text.

opciones.texto: Handicrafts and traditional souvenirs reflect the skill of the community.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Keeping your receipt is very useful if you need to exchange an item.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Based on the market exchange, how much does the item selected by the customer cost?

opciones.texto: Twenty baht (ยี่สิบบาท)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the seller answers «ราคาเท่ากันครับ ยี่สิบบาทครับ».
Incorrect: the number spoken is twenty («ยี่สิบ»).
Incorrect: it has a fixed sale price.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
